assessment: expo-router reaches decode-uri-component through query-string, and route or callback parsing may process attacker-controlled encoded input in production. 2026-10-17 recheck: decode-uri-component 0.2.2 is installed at node_modules/decode-uri-component; query-string 7.1.3 requires ^0.2.2, while the published fixed decoder is 0.5.0 (outside that pre-1.0 minor contract). No compatible query-string 7 change is available. Callback parsing can process hostile URLs; the HTTPS callback predicate and bounded application input reduce exposure but do not fix the transitive decoder. Retain reachable=uncertain; no device exploit claim.
mitigation: Strict callback and route allowlisting reduces exposure but is only a partial mitigation and does not fix the vulnerable decoder.
upgradePath: Upgrade expo-router or query-string to a compatible release that removes the affected decode-uri-component version, then remove this exception. Recheck published fixes on 2026-10-24; this residual expires 2026-10-31. No npm audit fix --force or incompatible Expo downgrade is permitted.
